maddeler.e:
نتصارع (form VI)
# نَتَصَارَعُ (nataṣāraʕu) /na.ta.sˤaː.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
# نَتَصَارَعَ (nataṣāraʕa) /na.ta.sˤaː.ra.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
# نَتَصَارَعْ (nataṣāraʕ) /na.ta.sˤaː.raʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَارَعَ (taṣāraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
